    total_cap = sum(capacities)

        best_num = None
        best_den = None

                den = allocations[i] + 1
                if best_i is None:

                    best_num = num
                    best_den = den

                        best_i = i
                        best_num = num
                        best_den = den
        if best_i is None:
            break
        allocations[best_i] += 1
        remaining -= 1
    by_name = {names[i]: allocations[i] for i in range(n)}
